mapper.sql: SELECT tra.*, t.name AS team_name, tr.position_name AS recruitment_position_name FROM team_recruitment_application tra LEFT JOIN team t ON tra.team_id = t.id LEFT JOIN team_recruitment tr ON tra.recruitment_id = tr.id
mapper.select: WHERE tra.team_id = #{teamId} ORDER BY tra.create_time DESC
WHERE tra.recruitment_id = #{recruitmentId} ORDER BY tra.create_time DESC
WHERE tra.applicant_id = #{applicantId} ORDER BY tra.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team_recruitment_application ( recruitment_id, team_id, applicant_id, applicant_name, applicant_role, desired_position, applicant_college_id, applicant_college_name, applicant_major, qualifications, answer_content, resume_url, remark, approval_status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{recruitmentId}, #{teamId}, #{applicantId}, #{applicantName}, #{applicantRole}, #{desiredPosition}, #{applicantCollegeId}, #{applicantCollegeName}, #{applicantMajor}, #{qualifications}, #{answerContent}, #{resumeUrl}, #{remark}, #{approvalStatus}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
